Speaker 1: We are testing whether a podcast model can run completely on a modern Android phone.
Speaker 2: First, we will create this short reference clip locally. Then every mobile runtime must reproduce the same voices and words.
noise_schedule: chunk 0 is the captured pinned latent; chunks 1..63 use torch CPU Generator.manual_seed(42), indexed exactly once per diffusion token

state_contract.qwen: prefill once; replace all 56 caches after every token decode; positions 503+n
state_contract.decoder: first entry for chunk 0, cached entry with all preceding 34 outputs thereafter
state_contract.semantic: first entry for chunk 0, cached entry with all preceding 34 outputs thereafter
state_contract.pcm: append each 3,200-sample chunk once in production order; no overlap/crossfade

documented_valid_termination: The cached decoder and semantic PTEs were exported for call 1. Call-1 cache outputs have wider static time axes than call-1 inputs, so they cannot feed call 2. The controller terminates CAPACITY after two correctly chained chunks rather than corrupting state by truncating, padding, resetting, duplicating, or reordering caches.
